title: Canonical proper integration counit
statement:
In the finite site coordinates for $\ell,E,n,A$, let $T$ be Noetherian with $\ell$ invertible, let $q:\mathbf P^1_T\to T$, and let $r\geq0$ kill $A$ by $\ell^{r+1}$. For every $K\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, identify $C(Lq_e^*K\otimes^L L_P[2])$ with $Lq_p^*CK\otimes^L CL_P[2]$ by the canonical tensorator and pullback square. The coefficient-first proper projection at these objects is invertible. The normalized projective counit in the ordered integration node is its inverse followed by $1\otimes t_q^p$ and the comparison constant right unitor. The trace $t_q^p$ is the supported-Kummer, second-projection trace, not a chosen ordinary trace transport.

proof.text: Put A = finiteTateCoefficient l E n, P = ProjectiveLine T, q : P -> T, and M = ordinaryFiniteLine A (l^(r+1)) hA P shifted by 2. The positive power l^(r+1) is invertible on P by mapping the unit l along q.appTop and taking a power. Taking germs gives invertibility at every stalk. Apply finite_etale_torsion_twist_line with exponent 1. Its finite-limit-preservation clause makes the Tate line flat over A itself; no flatness over Z/l^(r+1) is assumed.

The degree-zero flat Tate line has Tor amplitude [0,0]; the shift by 2 gives amplitude [-2,-2]. Choose a lower bound a for K. Exact etale pullback preserves that bound, using leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. The proved source API DerivedCategory.isGE_tensor_of_torAmplitudeIn gives the lower bound -2+a for M tensor Lq* K. M itself is bounded below by the existing linePlus construction. These are direct specializations of the flat-single, shift and tensor-bound APIs; the lower bound uses no upper bound or Tor amplitude on K.

Apply the unbounded proper torsion projection theorem to q and the finite ring A, via the existing isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_of_finite. Transport its component at (M,K) to the pro-etale projection using isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_app_app_leftDerived and the two bounded-below facts from the previous step. Replace left-derived comparison by exact derived comparison through leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. The coefficient-first properProjection is this invertible map preceded by the canonical signed symmetry and followed by its functorial image, so it too is invertible.

For the specified supported projective trace t, take properIntegration: the inverse of properProjection followed by tensoring t and the canonical right unitor. The hom-inverse identity proves ProperIntegrationEquation. Since properProjection is an isomorphism, precomposition with it is injective; cancel it to show any other solution equals the constructed map. Thus existsUniqueProjectiveEpsilon holds and the existing definition projectiveEpsilon selects its uniquely characterized value.
